preheader: Four replies owed, five bumps, two visits, and one name running hot.
headline: Four replies owed,
five bumps, two visits.
lede: The sweep found four names waiting on an answer and five sitting past their bump window. Open on Pinewood Cabinetry, which has read the last send seven times in twelve days.

scoreboard.details: Two are waiting on a number, two on a date.
Nothing is close enough to ask.
Both are walkable from the desk.

names.note: Owed a number since Tuesday, sending as Atelic, graded A.
Day 9 on the first send, no open yet.

counts.top_opened: Salley Wilson, Pinewood Cabinetry, 7 opens on day 12

flags.lead: Harbor Line Plumbing reads NEW with a reply on the record.
flags.note: The portal says NEW and the mailbox carries a reply from Thursday. Move it to CONTACTED, or say why not.
